name: nudge
author: Matt Godbolt <matt@godbolt.org>
description: Local keyboard-driven triage inbox for YouTube comments, GitHub and todos

scripts.start: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production node dist/server/server/index.js
scripts.demo: NUDGE_DEMO=1 NUDGE_DEMO_SUGGEST=1 NUDGE_DEMO_HISTORY=1 NUDGE_DB=data/demo.db npm run dev
scripts.demo:e2e:github: NUDGE_DEMO=1 NUDGE_DEMO_GITHUB=1 NUDGE_DB=:memory: NUDGE_PORT=$((4521+${E2E_PORT_OFFSET:-0})) NUDGE_DEMO_CLOCK=fixed tsx server/index.ts

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && svelte-check --tsconfig web/tsconfig.json
